name: The Maca Team
description: Specialist brand focused exclusively on organic Peruvian maca since 2009, selling maca powders, capsules, extracts, chips and blends in red, black, yellow and tri-color varieties through its own store, with a direct affiliate program for wellness creators and educators.

evidence.summary: The Maca Team's official affiliate page publishes a 20% commission on qualifying referred sales of its organic Peruvian maca products and states verbatim: 'There is no cap on how much you can earn. The more qualified customers you refer, the more commission you can generate.' Applications run through the brand's own direct affiliate program, with an AvantLink network option also offered on the same page. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording.

The same page says the program is built for content creators, wellness educators, bloggers, recipe creators, practitioners and publishers, and provides referral links, marketing images, banners, text links, approved brand copy and a tracking dashboard inside the affiliate portal.

reasons.niche_fit: A single-ingredient superfood specialist fits plant-based, smoothie, recipe and men's/women's wellness creator content with deep educational material to promote.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public program page explicitly recruiting content creators and recipe creators, with banners, images and approved copy supplied; no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 20% flat on qualifying sales with a verified 'no cap on how much you can earn' statement on the official page.
reasons.contact_access: No program email is published on the fetched page (a phone number is); joining and contact run through the affiliate portal, so access is scored mid-range.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Apply to the direct program on the official page, or join via AvantLink; approval required.
reasons.credibility: Maca-only specialist operating since 2009 with a deep product line and educational guides, per its own pages.

reasons.opportunity_availability: Application via Social Snowball for creators or Everflow for publishers; the page frames it as an exclusive partner group, so availability is scored conservatively.
reasons.credibility: Established collagen brand with a long-running partner program across multiple networks and published payout terms.
